name: shop-app
title: Shop app screen
description: A generic shopping app on a phone screen, 720x1560 for 9 seconds: the search bar types a query with a blinking caret, four product cards rise in one after another, the first is tapped, its page slides in with name, price, rating and a button, the button is pressed and a toast with a check mark confirms it. Lines: the query, the product's name, its price, the button and the toast; the defaults are placeholders ("Product name", "$49"), so set them for the user's product. Put it below the phone device frame; it renders in a headless browser.

name: route-map-3d
title: 3D route map
description: A dark city seen from above at a tilt, 1080x1920 for 7 seconds, rendered with Three.js: blocks of lit buildings from a seed, a glowing route drawn on along the streets with a dot riding its head, and a map pin that drops in at its end, while the camera tilts down, turns and pushes in. route lists street crossings (x, y) from the middle of the grid; turns follow the streets. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

params.name: seed
params.description: Picks the buildings: the same seed gives the same city.

params.name: blocks
params.description: City blocks along each side of the grid.

params.name: route
params.description: Street crossings the route passes, as [x, y] pairs counted in blocks from the middle; between two crossings it runs along x, then y.

params.name: ground_color
params.description: The ground between the blocks.

params.name: block_color
params.description: The buildings.

params.name: street_color
params.description: The faint lines along the streets.

params.name: window_color
params.description: The lit windows.

params.name: route_color
params.description: The route's glow.

params.name: dot_color
params.description: The dot at the route's head.

params.name: pin_color
params.description: The pin at the route's end.

params.name: max_height
params.description: The tallest buildings, in block widths; buildings along the route stay low.

params.name: draw_start
params.description: When the route starts drawing, in seconds.

params.name: draw_duration
params.description: How long the route takes to draw, in seconds.

params.name: pin_delay

params.name: turn

name: parcel-drop-3d
title: 3D parcel drop
description: A cardboard parcel with a logo printed on its front drops onto a floor, 1080x1920 for 4 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it falls with a little spin, squashes on impact, bounces and settles, with a soft contact shadow, a dust ring, a burst of sparks and a small camera shake. logo takes an image or SVG asset (FossCut's own mark when empty). Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

name: phone-3d
title: 3D phone with a live screen
description: A modern generic phone in 3D with rounded corners, a metal frame and a rim glow, 1080x1920 for 6 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it rises into view, turns towards the camera and the camera pushes in. Its screen shows a live web composition (the shop-app screen by default, playing on its own clock from screen_start), or an image or video asset. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur on the phone; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

name: logo-extrude-3d
title: 3D extruded logo
description: A logo extruded into a solid with bevelled edges, 1080x1920 for 4 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it swings in from the side, settles with a little overshoot, and a band of light sweeps across its face before it turns slowly. logo takes an SVG asset with filled shapes (FossCut's own mark when empty). Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

name: product-podium-3d
title: 3D product on a podium
description: A product turning on a lit podium, 1080x1920 for 6 seconds, rendered with Three.js: the product rises onto the podium, the turntable spins, a ring of light glows round the podium's edge, the floor and podium top reflect it, and the camera pushes in. product takes an image asset (shown as a card) or a glTF model asset; a FossCut-made bottle when empty. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).
